# BX Media Automotive

> BX Media Automotive (also known as BX Media) is an automotive content and video production agency based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It produces cinematic videos, social media content and influencer campaigns for car brands, dealerships, detailing and service centres, and motorsport organisers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

Key facts:
- Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Serves: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman.
- Specialisation: the automotive industry.
- Notable result: nine long-form YouTube episodes produced with ArabGT covering SAMF motorsport championships, with over 1M organic views.
- New enquiries: a reply within 24 hours with a tailored content roadmap.

## Services
- [Automotive Video Production in Riyadh](https://bx.media/services/automotive-video-production/): BX Media Automotive is a Riyadh-based production company that specialises in video for the automotive industry: vehicle launch reels, brand films, long-form YouTube episodes, event coverage and social cutdowns for car brands, dealerships, detailing studios and motorsport organisers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
- [Social Media Management for Automotive Brands](https://bx.media/services/automotive-social-media-management/): BX Media Automotive manages social media accounts for automotive businesses in Saudi Arabia: we plan the content calendar, shoot and edit the reels in-house, publish, and optimise based on performance. Because we are an automotive production house, the content is made by the same team that films your cars.
- [Automotive Influencer Marketing in Saudi Arabia](https://bx.media/services/automotive-influencer-marketing/): BX Media Automotive runs automotive influencer campaigns in Saudi Arabia: we match brands with relevant car creators, plan the concept, produce the content with our own crew and deliver it ready to publish. Work includes a Toyota LC300 HEV MAX off-road reel and a series of brand reels with creator @SaudiStig for Soueast, EVIQ, realme, Motul, TMD Friction and others.

## Industries
- [Car Brands, Distributors & Dealerships](https://bx.media/industries/car-brands-and-dealerships/): BX Media Automotive produces launch campaigns and ongoing content for car brands, distributors and dealerships in Saudi Arabia, from new model reveals to always-on social content. Our work includes the Hongqi HS3 launch at Boulevard Riyadh and a Toyota LC300 HEV MAX influencer reel for Abdul Latif Jameel.
- [Detailing, Service Centres & Aftermarket](https://bx.media/industries/detailing-and-service-centers/): BX Media Automotive makes showcase reels for detailing studios, paint protection specialists, service centres and aftermarket brands in Saudi Arabia, including Feynlab Riyadh, VIP Quick Service and Fix Auto, featuring cars such as Ferrari, Aston Martin, Lamborghini, Bentley and Nissan GT-R.
- [Motorsport, Events & Experiences](https://bx.media/industries/motorsport-and-events/): BX Media Automotive covers motorsport and automotive events across Saudi Arabia. With ArabGT we produced nine long-form YouTube episodes for SAMF championships, including hill climbs, drag racing and rallies, reaching over 1M organic views. We also documented a hypercar experience to AlUla and Umluj for Albassami and Seven Car Lounge.

## Case studies
- [Portfolio overview](https://bx.media/work/)
- [Pagani: Cinematic Hypercar Film](https://bx.media/work/pagani/): Cinematic widescreen hypercar film for Pagani, our newest production.
- [Albassami × Seven Car Lounge](https://bx.media/work/albassami-seven-car-lounge/): Campaign film and short-form reels documenting Albassami's hypercar transport for a Seven Car Lounge luxury drive experience to AlUla and Umluj.
- [ArabGT × SAMF](https://bx.media/work/arabgt-samf/): Nine long-form YouTube episodes produced with ArabGT covering SAMF national motorsport championships, from hill climbs and drag racing to rallies, with over 1M organic views.
- [Hongqi × StriveME](https://bx.media/work/hongqi-striveme/): Three cinematic vertical reels for the Hongqi HS3 launch at Boulevard Riyadh, produced with StriveME.
- [Toyota LC300 HEV MAX](https://bx.media/work/toyota-lc300-hev-max/): Off-road influencer reel with @SaudiStig showcasing the Toyota Land Cruiser LC300 HEV MAX hybrid for Abdul Latif Jameel.
- [Feynlab Riyadh Campaign](https://bx.media/work/feynlab-riyadh-campaign/): Eight polished reels for Feynlab Riyadh showcasing premium detailing and paint protection on Ferrari, Aston Martin, Lamborghini Urus, Range Rover, BMW, Nissan Patrol NISMO and Nissan GT-R.
- [VIP Quick Service](https://bx.media/work/vip-quick-service/): Four premium service reels for VIP Quick Service in Riyadh featuring Lamborghini Urus, Lamborghini and Bentley.
- [@SaudiStig Creator Collaborations](https://bx.media/work/saudistig-creator-collaborations/): Nine creator-led reels with @SaudiStig for Soueast, EVIQ, realme, 4Cars, TMD Friction, Titanium Automotive, Motul, Pendix and Petromin × RAM.
- [Dirab Drift Open Day](https://bx.media/work/dirab-drift-open-day/): Event recap film from a drift open day at Dirab Park, Riyadh.
- [Theeb × BMW: Suhail Edition](https://bx.media/work/theeb-bmw-suhail/): Cinematic 4K film for Theeb presenting the BMW Suhail Edition.
- [Fix Auto](https://bx.media/work/fix-auto/): Widescreen showcase film for the Fix Auto car care centre.
- [ArabGT: Red Eye Edit](https://bx.media/work/arabgt-red-eye-edit/): A short, high-energy Red Eye performance edit for ArabGT.

## FAQ
- What do you produce? Cinematic videos, social media content and creator campaigns, made for the automotive world: car brands, dealerships, car care centres, aftermarket brands and motorsport.
- Which brands have you worked with? Toyota, Abdul Latif Jameel, BYD, Lotus, Volvo, Soueast, EVIQ, ArabGT, SAMF, Feynlab, Motul and more. See the full portfolio for case studies.
- Do you work outside Riyadh? Yes. We're based in Riyadh, film all over Saudi Arabia and work with clients across the GCC.
- Can you handle our social media every month? Yes. Our monthly retainers cover planning, shooting, editing and posting, all by the same team.
